Each illustration contained completely within its own cell with at least 12% white padding on all sides. No visible grid, no dividers, no frames, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermarks. Clean flat shapes, saturated but harmonious colors, very little detail, crisp silhouettes, consistent subtle dark outlines; NOT photorealistic, no painterly texture. Clearly readable at 256x256. Each cell is an independent isolated icon, never a continuous scene. Include all 8 in precisely the specified row-major order. TOP row column 1: a single blue passenger car, side three-quarter view. TOP row column 2: an isolated curving gray asphalt road segment with white dashed center markings, no buildings or sidewalks. TOP row column 3: a compact whole city skyline of many colorful varied tall and low buildings. TOP row column 4: a small Georgian church with stone walls, conical central dome and a cross. BOTTOM row column 1: an outdoor produce market stall with striped awning, crates of fruit and vegetables. BOTTOM row column 2: a single detached cozy house with red roof and door. BOTTOM row column 3: a school building with a large school bell and a school backpack in front, no writing. BOTTOM row column 4: a large red location pin pinpointing a small house on a folded street map.
